settings.heading: Materials
settings.content: Premium water-resistant nylon with gold-tone hardware. Interior: microfiber lining with zip pocket and two card slots. Dust bag included.

settings.heading: Size & Fit
settings.content:
Height: 28cm | Width: 36cm | Depth: 12cm
Strap drop: 22cm adjustable shoulder strap
Magnetic snap closure

settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: Free standard shipping on orders over $200. Express 2-day shipping available. Returns accepted within 30 days of purchase in original, unworn condition with tags attached.

settings.heading: Absolutely stunning
settings.text: This bag exceeded all my expectations. The quality is impeccable and it holds so much more than it looks. I've received so many compliments!

settings.heading: My everyday luxury
settings.text: I was hesitant at first due to the price, but it's worth every penny. The puffer texture is gorgeous in person and the gold hardware elevates the entire look.

settings.heading: Lightweight perfection
settings.text: I travel a lot and this has become my go-to travel bag. Lightweight, spacious, and so chic. The water-resistant material saved me in the rain last week!
